body.statement: The horizon-adaptive feasible sets contain their deepest-pool counterparts, so \(W_{\mathrm{nested}}\le W_{\mathrm{deep}}\) and \(\Gamma_{\mathrm{nested}}\le\Gamma_{\mathrm{deep}}\) for every admissible fixed design.
body.justification: This is a sanity and boundary corollary of feasible-set inclusion, included without novelty credit.
body.gap: No literature gap is claimed for this tautological feasible-set implication; BenMichaelFellerRothstein2022 supplies only the shrinking-donor-set and common-support geometry anchor.
body.consumer: The boundary check lets \texttt{augsynth::multisynth} verify that enabling horizon-adaptive support cannot worsen the declared honest-width objective.
